Ein Haus mit Keller, Erdgeschoss, Oberge: A house with a cellar, ground floor, upper floor and attic – every floor at the right height.
Heute geht es um die Etagen. Im zweiten: Today it's all about the floors. In the second part we add the stairs and the openings in the floor.
Wir starten mit dem kleinen Haus aus Fol: We start with the small house from episode one: ground floor and upper floor.
Dazu kommen ein Keller unter der Erde un: We'll add a cellar below ground and an attic. Everything you see here is free.
Rechts oben stehen deine Etagen. Ein Kli: Your floors are listed at the top right. One click switches the floor in the plan – here the upper floor,
und das Erdgeschoss liegt gestrichelt da: and the ground floor lies dashed underneath. That way you draw neatly on top of each other.
Das Etagen-Formular siehst du immer dann: You see the floor form whenever nothing is selected. If a room is selected, click “Back to the floor” – in German „Zurück zur Etage“.

und die „Raumhöhe“: so hoch werden die W: and the “Ceiling height”, „Raumhöhe“: that's how tall the walls get. Below it, the link to the floor in Home Assistant.

Der Keller hat in Home Assistant die Ebe: In Home Assistant the cellar has level minus one.
Darum liegt er automatisch bei minus 2,7: So it automatically sits at minus 2.75 metres – below ground. And it's at the bottom of the list: floors are sorted from bottom to top.
Kellerräume sind oft niedriger. Ich stel: Cellar rooms are often lower. I set the ceiling height to 2.20.
Dann muss der Keller auch höher liegen:: Then the cellar has to sit higher too: ceiling height plus 25 centimetres of ceiling must reach exactly zero – so minus 2.45.
Die Faustregel gilt für jede Etage: Höhe: The rule of thumb works for every floor: elevation plus ceiling height plus ceiling gives the height of the next floor.
Die Kellerräume gibt es in Home Assistan: The cellar rooms already exist as areas in Home Assistant. This button adds a room for each of them – four in all.
Es sind Kacheln mit vier mal drei Metern: They're tiles of four by three metres, already linked to the right area. Now you move them into place.
Den Hobbyraum ziehe ich an den Heizungsr: I drag the hobby room to the boiler room – the corners snap into place.
Genau geht es mit den Feldern: Waschküch: For exact positions use the fields: tap the laundry room, “X” four, “Y” 3.12. The twelve-centimetre gap is like measuring from the inside.
Der Vorratsraum kommt daneben: „X“ null,: The storage room goes next to it: “X” zero, “Y” 3.12.
Hast du innen gemessen, liegen zwischen: If you measured inside, there are gaps between the rooms. “Close gaps” – „Lücken schließen“ – joins rooms up to 60 centimetres apart.
Unten steht, was passiert ist: zwei Stel: Below, it tells you what happened: two places closed, and the gap becomes an inner wall – twelve centimetres.
Der Keller ist kürzer als das Haus: 6,12: The cellar is shorter than the house: 6.12 instead of 7.5 metres. It should be flush with the lower outer wall – so 1.38 metres down.
Dafür ist „Etage verschieben“: das erste: That's what “Shift the floor” is for – „Etage verschieben“: the first field for X to the right, the second for Y down. Then click “Shift” – „Verschieben“.
Alles auf der Etage wandert mit: Räume,: Everything on the floor moves along: rooms, furniture, devices, outdoor areas, free walls and the background picture. The roof and cables stay put.
„90° drehen“ dreht die Etage im Uhrzeige: “Turn 90°” – „90° drehen“ – turns the floor clockwise around the centre of its rooms – in case you drew it turned.
Das will ich hier nicht: Strg+Z oder „Rü: I don't want that here: Ctrl+Z or “Undo” – „Rückgängig“ – brings everything back.
Mit dem Haken „Alle Etagen mitnehmen“ wi: With the tick “Take every floor along” – „Alle Etagen mitnehmen“ – shift and turn act on the whole house, with roof, garden, cables and meter.
Jetzt das Dachgeschoss. Es hat Ebene zwe: Now the attic. It has level two and lands at 5.50 metres – right above the upper floor.

Jetzt sind alle Etagen aus Home Assistan: Now every Home Assistant floor is taken. So “Add floor” right away adds an empty floor – on top of the house.
Bei „Etage in Home Assistant“ ist nichts: Under “Floor in Home Assistant” nothing is free any more – every HA floor already belongs to a floor in the plan.
„Nach oben“ und „Nach unten“ ändern nur: “Move up” and “Move down” – „Nach oben“, „Nach unten“ – only change the order in the list. Where a floor sits in the house is set by its elevation alone.
I don't need it: “Delete floor” – „Etage löschen“. After a confirmation it's gone with its rooms – Ctrl+Z brings it back.

… und klicke auf „Ansicht als Start der: … and click “View as this floor's start”. When you open the upper floor in 3D, it comes up exactly like this.

„Gestapelt“ setzt sie aufeinander. Von d: “Stacked” – „Gestapelt“ – puts them on top of each other. From the side you see: the cellar sits below ground, under the ground floor – and is a bit shorter than the house.
